messages:
mike_support: FYI customer ACCT-852 reporting streaming tool-call args getting cut mid-JSON on SSE over HTTP/2. Happened on /v1/chat/tool-invoke route when model tried to call external tool.

alex_dev: Can you paste the request_id and a raw chunk capture? Also which LB/proxy in front (GCLB/Envoy/Cloudflare)?

mike_support: request_id=req_0ab3f9c2, customer says path: /v1/chat/tool-invoke, using GCLB -> envoy proxy -> our frontend. They captured the SSE stream — the last event ends with a truncated JSON. Example chunk (copied from their tcpdump):

```
data: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"payments","args":{
data: "  \"tx\":{\"id\":\"tx-9c3\",\"amount\":100},\ndata: \"meta\":{\"user\":\"u-42\"}\n// <-- stream ended here, no closing braces or event terminator
```

maria_eng: hm. looks like an SSE event was split in the middle of the JSON. our SSE flusher inserts keepalive events periodically — if an upstream http2 window/FRAME boundary forces a mid-object split we could emit partial text. iirc the assembler has no brace-balancing guard.

tim_ops: Also check the proxy's http2 SETTINGS_ENABLE_PUSH and max frame size. nghttp2/Envoy can split frames on window updates. If keepalive is inserted as a separate chunk we might be reusing the same event buffer incorrectly. Can the customer repro with websockets? websocket avoids http2 chunk frame semantics.

jose_cust: can confirm repro with curl --http2 -N to our endpoint behind GCLB. Repro steps we used:
1) curl -v --http2 -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/tool-invoke?stream=true' \
2) send prompt that triggers toolcall large args (~4KB)
3) after ~30s we see an SSE event that ends abruptly. Attached hex/tcpdump for req_0ab3f9c2.

sara_support: thanks @jose_cust — can you try websocket if that's an option and paste back the raw ws frames? helps narrow to http2 frame splitting vs runtime JSON emitter bug. :thumbsup:

alex_dev: thanks for the repro. quick triage notes:
- our runtime currently emits tool-call args as a single SSE "data:" event and relies on chunking to stream gradually. no brace-counting sanity check.
- possible mitigations: (a) assemble token stream and only emit when top-level JSON closed, (b) guarantee each SSE event contains complete JSON by buffering across keepalives, (c) switch to chunked-JSON framing like newline-delimited JSON for tool args.

maria_eng: i'll spin up a debug build that adds a small assembler guard: ensure emitted SSE data has balanced braces at top level, otherwise buffer until found or timeout. can we run that on the customer's request-id?

mike_support: please do. i've flagged this P2 for the account and added labels: streaming, toolcall, http2-proxy. assigned to eng-runtime.

ingress-bot: New trace link for req_0ab3f9c2 -> https://internal-traces/redwood/req_0ab3f9c2 (redacted)

tim_ops: one more ask — capture Envoy logs with access log format including upstream_http2_frames and connection window updates. if we see a window_update immediately before the truncation that's a smoking gun.

jose_cust: i can run ws test tomorrow and re-upload tcpdump. for now we have the truncated chunk and full request/response timings. appreciate the quick responses.

alex_dev: good. next steps: maria will push a debug assembler to a canary and we will repro behind GCLB+Envoy. if confirmed we'll release a fix that ensures SSE emits only balanced top-level JSON for tool args. i'll leave notes in the bug with the reproduction steps and customer artifacts.

mike_support: great — please post the PR/issue id here once opened. thanks everyone. :pray:
